title: Air Force censorship of Pan-STARRS imagery

tellings.quote: A much smaller all sky survey called Pan Stars, the same one which discovered AmuA Mua, underwent massive censorship from the Air Force

plain: The Air Force is said to have heavily censored images from Pan-STARRS, a sky-scanning telescope survey. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and notes that Pan-STARRS is the same survey that discovered 'Oumuamua, an odd object that came into our solar system from outside it. He raises it because, if true, the military would be controlling what astronomers are allowed to see of the sky.
